exposure: placenta previa location (anterior, posterior, marginal, complete)
outcome: maternal complications (postpartum hemorrhage, blood transfusion requirement)
finding: Placenta previa location significantly influences maternal and neonatal outcomes, with complete placenta previa presenting the highest risks for cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the predominant mode of delivery (85%), especially with complete placenta previa, while vaginal deliveries primarily occurred in marginal placenta previa cases.
